quote: So we we take care of everything up front for you. So there's nothing out of pocket for you.
stewart_read: Rep answers a financing-mechanism question in full before any qualification has happened, giving away closer-tier content unprompted.

quote: Awesome. Do you know how much you're normally paying at the moment?

alternative_hypothesis: Reactive miss is likely correct here — there's no indication the rep considered a workaround; the customer's answer simply closed the door.
coaching_implication: Ask 'what were you paying at your last place?' to still get a bill-pain anchor even on a new move-in.

quote: I don't know about the the score of minus 6 something. He said, what's your score? Is it 650?
